data.long_meaning: Hanumant is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindu mythology. It is the name of Lord Hanuman, the monkey god who is an ardent devotee of Lord Rama. Hanamant means 'God's gift', 'God in human form', or 'given by God'. Hanuman is known for his strength, devotion, and selflessness. The name Hanamant carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hanamant usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Hanumant is a revered and beloved figure in Hindu mythology and culture. He is depicted as a monkey god with extraordinary strength and powers. The tales of Hanuman's devotion, courage, and loyalty to Lord Rama and Sita are popular in Hindu literature and have been passed down through generations. Hanuman temples and festivals dedicated to him are celebrated with great enthusiasm across India and in Hindu communities around the world. Hanuman is also depicted in various forms of art, such as sculpture, painting, and literature, and is a source of inspiration for many.
data.spiritual_significance: Hanumant represents the ideal qualities of devotion, selflessness, courage, and strength. He is a symbol of unwavering faith and is known to grant his devotees blessings, salvation, and protection. Hanuman's story teaches us the importance of devotion, sacrifice, and serving God selflessly. It also reminds us of the power of faith and the courage to face and overcome adversity, even when the odds seem insurmountable. Hanuman is a beloved and revered figure in Hinduism and his name carries with it a deep spiritual significance, inspiring us to be more devoted, selfless, and courageous in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hanumant represents unwavering devotion and selfless service to Lord Rama. His name signifies the strength and courage that comes from being deeply rooted in one's faith. Hanumant, the monkey god, embodies the power of a devoted heart and selfless actions.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Hanuman is a central character in the Indian epic Ramayana. The name Hanamant carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
